reason: Domino's 10-K filing discloses the size of the U.S. QSR pizza category ($43.4 billion in 2025, up from $42.8 billion in 2024) based on third-party market research from Circana's CREST. However, this market sizing comes from external analyst/research data (Circana), not from the company's own TAM disclosure. The filing explicitly states this data comes from 'ongoing foodservice market research prepared by Circana' and 'Although we believe this information to be reliable, we have not independently verified it.' No company-disclosed TAM for Domino's addressable market was found in the filing.
